tolerance_basis: p99 of |r_t - (holdings_price_return + income_return)| over 1098 reconciled account-days
plausibility_band_basis: the data's own p0.1 (-0.912047) or p99.9 (0.044193) reaches the PRD's default band, so the band is REPORTED against the default rather than silently widened -- a widening is the CTO's, not this cell's.
large_flow_share_recommendation_basis: p90 of |F_t| / V_(t-1) over the 13 account-days that actually carry a flow, not over all 1098. The unconditional p99 the order names is 1e-06 -- a percentile of zeros. NOT SUBSTITUTED HERE: `large_flow_share` still carries the order's own rule and this is a recommendation beside it, because changing which population a served threshold is measured over is the issuer's call.
